enrichment.headline: Awards $160,611 contract to A and B Mechanical to replace the boiler at Sequoia Elementary
enrichment.summary: A and B Mechanical, Inc. of Livermore will remove the old steam boiler at Sequoia Elementary School and install a new one. The work includes demolition, hazardous-materials cleanup as needed, reconnecting steam, gas and electrical lines, and testing the new equipment. The company was the lowest qualified bidder, and the $160,611 includes a $13,500 contingency, with work expected to run from October 15 to November 15, 2026.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.headline: Adds $30,415.99 for AGS, Inc. geotechnical and geologic hazard study at Melrose Leadership at Maxwell Park
enrichment.summary: This amendment pays AGS, Inc. up to $30,415.99 to do a geotechnical field study and a geologic hazard study for the new middle school building modernization project at Melrose Leadership at Maxwell Park. AGS will also coordinate with the California Geological Survey (CGS) and the Division of the State Architect (DSA) until the project is finished and state-certified. The work starts October 15, 2026, and runs until all assigned projects are complete. It is paid from the Measure Y building fund.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.summary: The board approves a conditional award letter from the City of Oakland that lets the City move forward with giving the district the right to redevelop and operate Sobrante Field, at the Sobrante Park recreational facilities at 470 El Paseo Drive.
